description: A detached shingle-clad house with a gabled front, decorative arched trim, a brick chimney and brick front steps over a front lawn. The living room has a white brick fireplace, a beamed ceiling, hardwood floors, a cast-iron radiator and a window seat under three windows. The dining room has a second white brick fireplace, built-in glass-front cabinets and a large window. The kitchen has white shaker cabinets, white countertops and a stainless steel side-by-side fridge. The lower level has a family room with white wainscoting, vinyl plank floors and above-grade windows. Upstairs, the attic has exposed rafters and wide-plank wood floors. Outside, a fenced side patio has string lights.
review_notes: Front exterior shows palm-type and tropical plants (bird-of-paradise/banana-leaf plants at right, spiky palm at left) that don't fit Ontario.
No bedroom or bathroom photos: beds (4) and baths (2) are guesses based on house size (2.5 storeys plus lower level). Description does not mention them; check before use.
Neighbouring house (blue Victorian) visible in exterior and dining room window; not claimed in copy.
